listing.name: Halo 3 — summers-aaron Halo3 Linux/SystemLink runtime family (summers-aaron)
listing.summary: Upstream reports startup, menus, campaign progress from Arrival into Sierra 117 and beyond, and System Link across instances or machines. A full campaign is unconfirmed. The experimental native graphics path is separate from the default Xenos renderer; Portcove has not tested either route. Follow the setup instructions below. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own Halo 3 Xbox 360 ISO. The README does not confirm the exact region, revision, title update or executable hash; check upstream before setup. Keep generated game binaries private and local.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Run setup-halo3.sh with your own ISO as upstream directs to build the patched ReXGlue SDK and game locally. Use play-halo3.sh to launch. Its optional --zt option configures System Link over ZeroTier. No public ready-to-use player is confirmed.
